svg.title: Why size saves two bytes in the same four-color band
svg.desc: Two panels encode the same eight by six blue, amber, green, and pink grid. Auto and fast preserve every hole in a 25-byte paint body. Size paints solid amber and pink rectangles, repairs blue and green pixels, and uses a 23-byte paint body.
svg.text: Why size saves two bytes in the same four-color band
It replaces two hole-shaped masks with solid runs, then repairs the safe overdraw.
No pixel is temporarily painted with another color.
Blue and green safely repaint the temporary overdraw.
